generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone high-resolution square sci-fi industrial design concept rendering of The Witness Core. Monumental Precision: solemn minimal geometry, heavy material, exact manufacture.
Input images: Image 1 is a SECONDARY reference for clean continuous metal edges, bevel precision and simple silhouette only; do not copy its connected cube cage. Image 2 is the PRIMARY reference for nested square-frame hierarchy, dark heavy metal, different three-dimensional frame orientations and a bright central cube. Replace its fractured, rough, confusing edges with immaculate geometry. These are visual references, not extra objects to place in the scene.
Strict construction: exactly FOUR independent objects total: ONE central optical CUBE and exactly THREE separate, COMPLETE CLOSED SQUARE METAL FRAMES. Each frame is a single continuous planar square loop consisting of four equal straight beams and four precise 90-degree corners. Each loop has true solid rectangular beam depth, coherent front, inner and side faces, and the same uniform beam cross-section along its entire perimeter. All three frames share one manufacturing grammar and the SAME beam cross-section within this design. Small consistent machined bevels only; no inset decorative bands that look like extra rings.
Nested outer/middle/inner square sizes approximately 100 / 75 / 55; central cube about 20. Slight ratio adjustment is allowed for clear air gaps. All four share ONE geometric center, but frame planes have distinct restrained tilts and axial orientations, not all parallel. Create a clear largest outer loop, a smaller middle loop and a smallest inner loop around the cube. Each full square loop must remain visually traceable: avoid orientations that collapse it edge-on. Rational front-to-back occlusion with readable depth, no physically fused corners or obvious solid intersections. Leave air between adjacent frames and around the core. The frames suggest slow independent rotation about their common center, without asserting full-angle collision freedom. This is neither three concentric circular rings nor an open cube cage.
Core: a pure milky-WHITE optical glass CUBE with six flat square faces and crisp right-angle edges, faint translucency and readable top/front/side faces. Bright pale material rather than a luminous effect; retain tonal detail, NO blown-out white blob, NO bloom or halo, no sphere, gemstone points or crystal pendant.
Presentation: one centered entity floating freely, fully visible with generous margins on all sides, approximately 76 percent of the square canvas. Consistent long-lens three-quarter view, looking slightly down. Seamless DARK GRAY studio background and subdued floor/shadow. Soft directional key from upper left, soft neutral fill and subtle neutral edge separation, showing thickness and precision. Deep graphite metal retains detail in the shadows. Museum-quality industrial design rendering, plausible three-dimensional construction, restrained material contrast. No environment or props.
Avoid: broken shells, open C-frames, partial frames, extra fourth/fifth metal ring, cube wireframe cages, cross braces, floating fragments, armor, small mechanical parts, joints, wires, decorative bands, runes, greebles, ragged edges, burrs, silver mirror chrome, blue/purple neon, flare, particles, smoke, magic, dramatic glow, text, logo, watermark, labels, contact sheet, multi-view diagram, cropped object.

Use thick solid beams, approximately 6 percent of the outer frame side in face width and 7 percent in depth, the same cross-section on all three loops. Dark blackened forged steel with a controlled satin finish and fine subtle manufacturing grain, only very slight wear. All faces and cuts perfectly regular. Prioritize three unambiguous closed squares, a small white cube, generous precision gaps and the heavy artifact presence.
